scope_note: This is Breuer's own 1908 statement about his role after the 1895 book. It bounds later-development attribution without erasing his earlier cathartic contribution.
statement: In the 1908 second-edition preface, Breuer stated that he had taken no active part in the subject's important development after the 1895 book.
statement_zh: Breuer 在 1908 年第二版序言中表示，1895 年後他沒有積極參與這一主題的重要發展。
